The CPU architecture. Valid values:

CPU 架构。取值范围如下：

- ARM

parameters.help_en:

- **PostgreSQL**

- **MySQL**
- **PostgreSQL**
- **Oracle**

The database engine version.
* Valid values for MySQL: 
    * **5.6**
    * **5.7**
    * **8.0**
* Valid values for PostgreSQL:
    * **11**
    * **14**
    * **15**

    * **5.7**

    * **11**
    * **14**
    * **15**

    * **14**

parameters.help_en:
The node specification. For more information, see the following topics:

- PolarDB for MySQL: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102542.html.
- PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Compatible with Oracle): https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207921.html.
- PolarDB for PostgreSQL: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209380.html.

>  - To create a serverless cluster for PolarDB for MySQL Cluster Edition, set this parameter to **polar.mysql.sl.small**.
> - To create a serverless cluster for PolarDB for MySQL Standard Edition, set this parameter to **polar.mysql.sl.small.c**.
> - To create a serverless cluster for PolarDB for PostgreSQL Cluster Edition, set this parameter to **polar.pg.sl.small**.
> - To create a serverless cluster for PolarDB for PostgreSQL Standard Edition, set this parameter to **polar.pg.sl.small.c**.
> - To create a serverless cluster for PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Compatible with Oracle), set this parameter to **polar.o.sl.small**
parameters.help_zh:
节点规格，详情请参见如下文档：

- PolarDB MySQL版：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102542.html。
- PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207921.html。
- PolarDB PostgreSQL版：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209380.html。

>  - PolarDB MySQL集群版如需创建Serverless集群，请传入**polar.mysql.sl.small**。
> - PolarDB MySQL标准版如需创建Serverless集群，请传入**polar.mysql.sl.small.c**。
> - PolarDB PostgreSQL集群版如需创建Serverless集群，请传入**polar.pg.sl.small**。
> - PolarDB PostgreSQL标准版如需创建Serverless集群，请传入**polar.pg.sl.small.c**。
> - PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）如需创建Serverless集群，请传入**polar.o.sl.small**

parameters.help_en: The network type of the cluster. Only Virtual Private Cloud (VPC) is supported. Set the value to **VPC**

parameters.help_en:

集群名称，集群名称需满足如下要求：
* 不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
* 长度为2~256个字符
parameters.name: db_cluster_description

parameters.help_en:

- **Prepaid**: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值范围如下：

- **Prepaid**：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

- **true**: Auto-renewal is enabled.
- **false**: Auto-renewal is disabled.

Default value: **false**.

> This parameter takes effect only when **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动续费，取值范围如下：

- **true**：自动续费。
- **false**：不自动续费。

默认为**false**。

> 当参数**PayType**取值为**Prepaid**时，该参数才生效
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is required when **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**. Pass this parameter to specify whether the upfront cluster uses a yearly or monthly billing cycle. 

- **Year**: The subscription period is measured in years.
- **Month**: The subscription period is measured in months
parameters.help_zh:
若付费类型为**Prepaid**时，该参数为必传参数。指定预付费集群为包年或包月类型。 

- **Year**：包年。即选择包年包月时，单位为年。
- **Month**：包月。即选择包年包月时，单位为月
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
This parameter is required when **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**.
- When **Period** is set to **Month**, the valid values of **UsedTime** are integers in the range of `[1-9]`.
- When **Period** is set to **Year**, the valid values of **UsedTime** are integers in the range of `[1-3]`
parameters.help_zh:
若付费类型为**Prepaid**时，该参数为必传参数。
- 当**Period**为**Month**时，**UsedTime**取值为整数类型，取值范围为`[1-9]`。
- 当**Period**为**Year**时，**UsedTime**取值为整数类型，取值范围为`[1-3]`
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_zh: 专有网络ID

parameters.help_zh:
虚拟交换机ID。

parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The method used to create the cluster. Valid values: 

* **Normal**: Creates a new PolarDB cluster. For console operations, see the following topics:

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/58769.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118063.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118182.html

* **CloneFromPolarDB**: Clones data from an existing PolarDB cluster to a new PolarDB cluster. For console operations, see the following topics:

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87966.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118108.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118221.html

* **RecoverFromRecyclebin**: Recovers data from a released PolarDB cluster to a new PolarDB cluster. For console operations, see the following topics:

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/164880.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/432844.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424632.html

* **CloneFromRDS**: Clones data from an existing ApsaraDB RDS instance to a new PolarDB cluster. For console operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121812.html.

* **MigrationFromRDS**: Migrates data from an existing ApsaraDB RDS instance to a new PolarDB cluster. The created PolarDB cluster is in read-only pattern and has binary logging enabled by default. For console operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121582.html.

* **CreateGdnStandby**: Creates a secondary cluster. For console operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160381.html.

* **UpgradeFromPolarDB**: Performs instance migration from PolarDB. For console operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459712.html.

Default value: **Normal**.

> When **DBType** is set to **MySQL** and **DBVersion** is set to **8.0**, you can set this parameter to **CreateGdnStandby**
parameters.help_zh:
创建方式，取值范围如下： 

* **Normal**：创建一个全新的PolarDB集群，控制台操作请参见如下文档：

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/58769.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118063.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118182.html

* **CloneFromPolarDB**：从现有PolarDB集群克隆数据到新的PolarDB集群，控制台操作请参见如下文档：

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87966.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118108.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118221.html

* **RecoverFromRecyclebin**：从已释放的PolarDB集群恢复数据到新的PolarDB集群，控制台操作请参见如下文档：

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/164880.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/432844.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424632.html

* **CloneFromRDS**：从现有RDS实例克隆数据到新的PolarDB集群，控制台操作请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121812.html；

* **MigrationFromRDS**：从现有RDS实例迁移数据到新的PolarDB集群。创建的PolarDB集群是只读模式，且默认开启Binlog。控制台操作请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121582.html。

* **CreateGdnStandby**：创建一个从集群，控制台操作请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160381.html。

* **UpgradeFromPolarDB**：从PolarDB升级迁移，控制台操作请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459712.html。

默认为**Normal**。

> 当**DBType**为**MySQL**且**DBVersion**为**8.0**时，本参数取值可以为**CreateGdnStandby**
parameters.name: creation_option

parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the source ApsaraDB RDS instance or the source PolarDB cluster. This parameter is required only when **CreationOption** is set to **MigrationFromRDS**, **CloneFromRDS**, **CloneFromPolarDB**, or **RecoverFromRecyclebin**.
* If **CreationOption** is set to **MigrationFromRDS** or **CloneFromRDS**, set this parameter to instance ID of the source ApsaraDB RDS instance. The source ApsaraDB RDS instance must run RDS MySQL 5.6, 5.7, or 8.0 on RDS High-availability Edition.

* If **CreationOption** is set to **CloneFromPolarDB**, set this parameter to instance ID of the source PolarDB cluster. The cloned cluster and the source cluster have the same DBType by default. For example, if the source cluster runs MySQL 8.0, set **DBType** to **MySQL** and **DBVersion** to **8.0** for the cloned cluster.
* If **CreationOption** is set to **RecoverFromRecyclebin**, set this parameter to instance ID of the released source PolarDB cluster. The recovered cluster and the source cluster must have the same DBType. For example, if the source cluster runs MySQL 8.0, set **DBType** to **MySQL** and **DBVersion** to **8.0** for the recovered cluster
parameters.help_zh:
源RDS实例ID或源PolarDB集群ID。仅当**CreationOption**为**MigrationFromRDS**、**CloneFromRDS**、**CloneFromPolarDB**或**RecoverFromRecyclebin**时，该参数必填。
* 若**CreationOption**为**MigrationFromRDS**或**CloneFromRDS**，您需要为本参数传入源RDS实例ID。源RDS实例版本需为RDS MySQL 5.6 、5.7或8.0高可用版。

* 若**CreationOption**为**CloneFromPolarDB**，您需要为本参数传入源PolarDB集群ID。克隆集群和源集群的DBType默认保持一致。例如源集群为MySQL 8.0，则克隆集群也需设置**DBType**为**MySQL**且**DBVersion**为**8.0**。
* 若**CreationOption**为**RecoverFromRecyclebin**，您需要为本参数传入已释放的源PolarDB集群ID。从回收站恢复的集群和源集群的DBType需保持一致。例如源集群为MySQL 8.0，则从回收站恢复的集群也需设置**DBType**为**MySQL**且**DBVersion**为**8.0**
parameters.name: source_resource_id

parameters.help_en:
The point in time at which data is cloned. Valid values: 

-  **LATEST**: The latest point in time.
- **BackupID**: A historical backup set ID. Specify the actual backup set ID.
- **Timestamp**: A historical point in time. Specify the actual time in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format (UTC).

 Default value: **LATEST**.

> If **CreationOption** is set to **CloneFromRDS**, this parameter can only be set to **LATEST**
parameters.help_zh:
克隆数据的时间节点，取值： 

-  **LATEST**：最新时间点的数据。
- **BackupID**：历史备份集ID，请传入具体的备份集ID。
- **Timestamp**：历史时间点，请传入具体的时间，格式：`YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`（UTC时间）。

 默认为**LATEST**。

> 若**CreationOption**为**CloneFromRDS**，则本参数取值只能为**LATEST**
parameters.name: clone_data_point

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. It is case-sensitive and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII 字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses in the whitelist of the PolarDB cluster.
> You can specify multiple IP addresses. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh:
PolarDB集群白名单IP地址。
>支持配置多个白名单IP地址，多个IP地址之间使用英文逗号分隔
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Transparent Data Encryption (TDE). Valid values:

- **true**: TDE is enabled.
- **false**: TDE is disabled. This is the default value.

> * This parameter takes effect only when **DBType** is set to **PostgreSQL** or **Oracle**.
> * You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167982.html operation to enable TDE for a PolarDB for MySQL cluster.
> * TDE cannot be disabled after it is enabled
parameters.help_zh:
开启TDE加密。取值范围如下：

- **true**：开启。
- **false**：关闭（默认值）。

> * 仅当**DBType**为**PostgreSQL**或**Oracle**时，本参数生效。
> * 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167982.html接口为PolarDB MySQL集群开启TDE加密。
> * TDE功能开启后不可关闭
parameters.name: tde_status

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the global database network (GDN).

> This parameter is required when **CreationOption** is set to **CreateGdnStandby**
parameters.help_zh:
全球数据库网络ID。

> 当**CreationOption**为**CreateGdnStandby**时，本参数必填
parameters.name: gdn_id

parameters.help_en:
The edition of the cluster. Valid values:
* **Normal**: Cluster Edition. This is the default value.
* **Basic**: Single Node Edition.
* **ArchiveNormal**: X-Engine Edition.
* **NormalMultimaster**: Multi-master Cluster Edition.
* **SENormal**: Standard Edition.

> * **MySQL** **5.6**, **5.7**, **8.0**, **PostgreSQL** **14**, and **Oracle syntax-compatible 2.0** support **Basic**.
> * **MySQL** **8.0** supports **ArchiveNormal** and **NormalMultimaster**.
> * **MySQL** **5.6**, **5.7**, **8.0**, and **PostgreSQL** **14** support **SENormal**.

For more information about editions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183258.html
parameters.help_zh:
产品系列，取值范围如下：
* **Normal**：集群版（默认值）
* **Basic**：单节点
* **ArchiveNormal**：高压缩引擎（X-Engine）
* **NormalMultimaster**：多主架构集群版
* **SENormal**：标准版

> * **MySQL** **5.6**、**5.7**、**8.0**，**PostgreSQL** **14**以及**Oracle语法兼容 2.0版**支持**Basic**。
> * **MySQL** **8.0**支持**ArchiveNormal**和**NormalMultimaster**。
> * **MySQL** **5.6**、**5.7**、**8.0**和**PostgreSQL** **14**支持**SENormal**。

更多关产品系列的介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/183258.html
parameters.name: creation_category

parameters.help_en:
The default time zone of the cluster (UTC). The value can be any time frame within the range of **-12:00 to +13:00**, such as **00:00**. Default value: **SYSTEM**, which indicates that the default time zone is the same as the time zone of the region.
> This parameter takes effect only when **DBType** is set to **MySQL**
parameters.help_zh:
集群时区（UTC），可选取值范围为**-12:00~+13:00**内的所有整点时间，如**00:00**。默认取值为**SYSTEM**，默认时区与Region所在时区一致。
>仅当**DBType**为**MySQL**时，该参数生效
parameters.name: default_time_zone

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether table names are case-sensitive. Valid values:
* **1**: Table names are case-insensitive.
* **0**: Table names are case-sensitive.

Default value: **1**.
> This parameter takes effect only when **DBType** is set to **MySQL**
parameters.help_zh:
表名是否区分大小写，取值范围如下：
* **1**：不区分大小写
* **0**：区分大小写

默认取值为**1**。
>仅当**DBType**为**MySQL**时，该参数生效
parameters.name: lower_case_table_names

parameters.help_en:
The data retention policy applied when the cluster is deleted. Valid values:
* **ALL**: All backups are retained for long-term retention (LTR).
* **LATEST**: The last backup is retained for long-term retention (LTR). An automatic backup is performed before deletion.
* **NONE**: No backups are retained when the cluster is deleted.

Default value: **NONE**, which means no backups are retained when the cluster is deleted.
>* This parameter takes effect only when **DBType** is set to **MySQL**.
>* Serverless clusters do not support this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
删除集群时备份集保留策略，取值范围如下：
* **ALL**：长期保留全部备份。
* **LATEST**：长期保留最后一个备份（删除前自动备份）。
* **NONE**：集群删除时不保留备份集。

创建集群时，默认取值为**NONE**，即集群删除时不保留备份集。
>* 仅当**DBType**为**MySQL**时，该参数生效。
>*  Serverless集群不支持该参数
parameters.name: backup_retention_policy_on_cluster_deletion

parameters.help_en:
The storage space for subscription billing (pay-by-space). Unit: GB.
> - Valid values for PolarDB for MySQL Enterprise Edition: 10 to 50000.
> - Valid values for PolarDB for MySQL Standard Edition: 20 to 64000.
> - When the Standard Edition storage type is ESSDAUTOPL, valid values are 40 to 64000 with a minimum step of 10. Only values such as 40, 50, 60, and so on are accepted
parameters.help_zh:
按空间计费（包年包月）的存储空间。单位：GB。
> - PolarDB MySQL企业版存储空间的取值范围：10~50000。
> - PolarDB MySQL标准版存储空间的取值范围：20~64000。
> - 标准版存储类型为ESSDAUTOPL时，存储空间的取值范围：40~64000，步长最小为10，即只能填写40、50、60...以此类推
parameters.name: storage_space

parameters.help_en:
The minor engine version. Valid values:

- **8.0.2**

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118182.html

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87966.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118108.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118221.html

* **RecoverFromRecyclebin**: Recovers data from a released PolarDB cluster to a new PolarDB cluster. For console operations, see the following topics:

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/164880.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/432844.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424632.html

* **CloneFromRDS**: Clones data from an existing ApsaraDB RDS instance to a new PolarDB cluster. For console operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121812.html.

* **MigrationFromRDS**: Migrates data from an existing ApsaraDB RDS instance to a new PolarDB cluster. The created PolarDB cluster is in read-only pattern and has binary logging enabled by default. For console operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121582.html.

* **CreateGdnStandby**: Creates a secondary cluster. For console operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160381.html.

* **UpgradeFromPolarDB**: Performs instance migration from PolarDB. For console operations, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459712.html.

Default value: **Normal**.

> When **DBType** is set to **MySQL** and **DBVersion** is set to **8.0**, you can set this parameter to **CreateGdnStandby**
v1_parameters.help_zh:
创建方式，取值范围如下： 

* **Normal**：创建一个全新的PolarDB集群，控制台操作请参见如下文档：

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/58769.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118063.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118182.html

* **CloneFromPolarDB**：从现有PolarDB集群克隆数据到新的PolarDB集群，控制台操作请参见如下文档：

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87966.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118108.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118221.html

* **RecoverFromRecyclebin**：从已释放的PolarDB集群恢复数据到新的PolarDB集群，控制台操作请参见如下文档：

    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/164880.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/432844.html
    * https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/424632.html

* **CloneFromRDS**：从现有RDS实例克隆数据到新的PolarDB集群，控制台操作请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121812.html；

* **MigrationFromRDS**：从现有RDS实例迁移数据到新的PolarDB集群。创建的PolarDB集群是只读模式，且默认开启Binlog。控制台操作请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/121582.html。

* **CreateGdnStandby**：创建一个从集群，控制台操作请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/160381.html。

* **UpgradeFromPolarDB**：从PolarDB升级迁移，控制台操作请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/459712.html。

默认为**Normal**。

> 当**DBType**为**MySQL**且**DBVersion**为**8.0**时，本参数取值可以为**CreateGdnStandby**
v1_parameters.name: CreationOption

v1_parameters.help_en:
The name of the cluster. The name must meet the following requirements:
* It cannot start with `http://` or `https://`.
* It must be 2 to 256 characters in length
v1_parameters.help_zh:
集群名称，集群名称需满足如下要求：
* 不能以`http://`或`https://`开头。
* 长度为2~256个字符
v1_parameters.name: DBClusterDescription

v1_parameters.help_en:
The minor engine version. Valid values:

- **8.0.2**

- **8.0.1**

> This parameter takes effect only when **DBType** is set to **MySQL** and **DBVersion** is set to **8.0**
v1_parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎小版本号。取值范围如下：

- **8.0.2**

- **8.0.1**

> 当参数**DBType**为**MySQL**且**DBVersion**为**8.0**时，该参数才生效
v1_parameters.name: DBMinorVersion

v1_parameters.help_en:
The node specification. For more information, see the following topics:

- PolarDB for MySQL: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102542.html.
- PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Compatible with Oracle): https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207921.html.
- PolarDB for PostgreSQL: https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209380.html.

>  - To create a serverless cluster for PolarDB for MySQL Cluster Edition, set this parameter to **polar.mysql.sl.small**.
> - To create a serverless cluster for PolarDB for MySQL Standard Edition, set this parameter to **polar.mysql.sl.small.c**.
> - To create a serverless cluster for PolarDB for PostgreSQL Cluster Edition, set this parameter to **polar.pg.sl.small**.
> - To create a serverless cluster for PolarDB for PostgreSQL Standard Edition, set this parameter to **polar.pg.sl.small.c**.
> - To create a serverless cluster for PolarDB for PostgreSQL (Compatible with Oracle), set this parameter to **polar.o.sl.small**
v1_parameters.help_zh:
节点规格，详情请参见如下文档：

- PolarDB MySQL版：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/102542.html。
- PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207921.html。
- PolarDB PostgreSQL版：https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/209380.html。

>  - PolarDB MySQL集群版如需创建Serverless集群，请传入**polar.mysql.sl.small**。
> - PolarDB MySQL标准版如需创建Serverless集群，请传入**polar.mysql.sl.small.c**。
> - PolarDB PostgreSQL集群版如需创建Serverless集群，请传入**polar.pg.sl.small**。
> - PolarDB PostgreSQL标准版如需创建Serverless集群，请传入**polar.pg.sl.small.c**。
> - PolarDB PostgreSQL版（兼容Oracle）如需创建Serverless集群，请传入**polar.o.sl.small**
v1_parameters.name: DBNodeClass

v1_parameters.help_en:
The number of nodes for Standard Edition and Enterprise Edition. Valid values:
- Standard Edition: 1 to 8 (supports 1 read/write node and 7 read-only nodes).
- Enterprise Edition: 1 to 16 (supports 1 read/write node and 15 read-only nodes).
> - Enterprise Edition has 2 nodes by default. Standard Edition has 1 node by default.
> - Only PolarDB for MySQL supports this parameter.
> - Changing the number of nodes for Multi-master Cluster Edition clusters is not supported
v1_parameters.help_zh:
标准版和企业版节点个数。取值如下：
- 标准版取值范围：1~8（支持1个读写节点和7个只读节点）。
- 企业版取值范围：1~16（支持1个读写节点和15个只读节点）。
> - 企业版默认有2个节点，标准版默认有1个节点。
> - 仅PolarDB MySQL版支持该参数。
>- 目前暂不支持多主集群节点数量变更设置
v1_parameters.name: DBNodeNum

v1_parameters.help_en:
The database engine type. Valid values: 

- **MySQL**
- **PostgreSQL**
- **Oracle**
v1_parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎类型，取值范围如下： 

- **MySQL**
- **PostgreSQL**
- **Oracle**
v1_parameters.name: DBType

v1_parameters.help_en:
The database engine version.
* Valid values for MySQL: 
    * **5.6**
    * **5.7**
    * **8.0**
* Valid values for PostgreSQL:
    * **11**
    * **14**
    * **15**
    <props="china">
      
      > To create a serverless cluster for PolarDB for PostgreSQL, only version 14 is supported. 
    
    </props>
* Valid values for Oracle:
    * **11**
    * **14**
v1_parameters.help_zh:
数据库引擎版本号。
* MySQL版本号取值范围如下： 
    * **5.6**
    * **5.7**
    * **8.0**
* PostgreSQL版本号取值范围如下：
    * **11**
    * **14**
    * **15**
    <props="china">
      
      > PolarDB PostgreSQL版中如需创建Serverless集群，版本号只支持14。 
    
    </props>
* Oracle版本号取值范围如下：
    * **11**
    * **14**
v1_parameters.name: DBVersion

v1_parameters.help_en:
The default time zone of the cluster (UTC). The value can be any time frame within the range of **-12:00 to +13:00**, such as **00:00**. Default value: **SYSTEM**, which indicates that the default time zone is the same as the time zone of the region.
> This parameter takes effect only when **DBType** is set to **MySQL**
v1_parameters.help_zh:
集群时区（UTC），可选取值范围为**-12:00~+13:00**内的所有整点时间，如**00:00**。默认取值为**SYSTEM**，默认时区与Region所在时区一致。
>仅当**DBType**为**MySQL**时，该参数生效
v1_parameters.name: DefaultTimeZone

v1_parameters.help_en: The ENS node ID required when creating an ENS database
v1_parameters.help_zh: 创建ENS数据库时，需要指定ENS的节点ID
v1_parameters.name: EnsRegionId

v1_parameters.help_en:
The ID of the global database network (GDN).

> This parameter is required when **CreationOption** is set to **CreateGdnStandby**
v1_parameters.help_zh:
全球数据库网络ID。

> 当**CreationOption**为**CreateGdnStandby**时，本参数必填
v1_parameters.name: GDNId

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the hot standby cluster. Valid values:

- **ON** (default): Enables the hot standby storage cluster.
- **OFF**: Disables the hot standby cluster.
- **STANDBY**: Enables the hot standby cluster.
- **EQUAL**: Enables both the hot standby storage cluster and the hot standby compute cluster.
- **3AZ**: Enables multi-zone strong data consistency.
> **STANDBY** takes effect only for PolarDB for PostgreSQL
v1_parameters.help_zh:
是否开启热备集群。取值范围如下：

- **ON**（默认）：开启存储热备集群。
- **OFF**：关闭热备集群。
- **STANDBY**：开启热备集群。
- **EQUAL**：开启存储热备和计算热备。
- **3AZ**：多可用区数据强一致。
>**STANDBY** 仅对PolarDB PostgreSQL版生效
v1_parameters.name: HotStandbyCluster

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the binary logging feature. Valid values:

- **ON**: Binary logging is enabled for the cluster.
- **OFF**: Binary logging is disabled for the cluster.
> This parameter takes effect only when **DBType** is set to **MySQL**
v1_parameters.help_zh:
开启Binlog功能，取值范围如下：

- **ON**：集群开启Binlog功能。
- **OFF**：集群关闭Binlog功能。
> 当参数**DBType**为**MySQL**时，该参数才生效
v1_parameters.name: LoosePolarLogBin

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the X-Engine storage engine. Valid values:

- **ON**: The X-Engine engine is enabled for the cluster.
- **OFF**: The X-Engine engine is disabled for the cluster.
> This parameter takes effect only when **CreationOption** is not set to **CreateGdnStandby**, **DBType** is set to **MySQL**, and **DBVersion** is set to **8.0**. The memory specification of nodes with X-Engine enabled must be 8 GB or more
v1_parameters.help_zh:
开启X-Engine存储引擎功能，取值范围如下：

- **ON**：集群开启X-Engine引擎。
- **OFF**：集群关闭X-Engine引擎。
> 当参数**CreationOption**不等于**CreateGdnStandby**，**DBType**为**MySQL**且**DBVersion**为**8.0**时，该参数才生效。开启X-Engine引擎的节点内存规格必须大于等于8 GB
v1_parameters.name: LooseXEngine

v1_parameters.help_en:
The percentage of memory allocated to the X-Engine storage engine. Valid values: integers from 10 to 90.
> This parameter takes effect only when **LooseXEngine** is set to **ON**
v1_parameters.help_zh:
设置开启X-Engine存储引擎比例，取值范围10~90的整数。
> 当参数**LooseXEngine**为**ON**时，该参数才生效
v1_parameters.name: LooseXEngineUseMemoryPct

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether table names are case-sensitive. Valid values:
* **1**: Table names are case-insensitive.
* **0**: Table names are case-sensitive.

Default value: **1**.
> This parameter takes effect only when **DBType** is set to **MySQL**
v1_parameters.help_zh:
表名是否区分大小写，取值范围如下：
* **1**：不区分大小写
* **0**：区分大小写

默认取值为**1**。
>仅当**DBType**为**MySQL**时，该参数生效
v1_parameters.name: LowerCaseTableNames

v1_parameters.help_en:
The ID of the parameter template.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207178.html operation to query the parameter template list in the specified region, including the parameter template ID
v1_parameters.help_zh:
参数模板ID。

> 您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/207178.html接口查看目标地域的参数模板列表，包括参数模板ID
v1_parameters.name: ParameterGroupId

v1_parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values: 

- **Postpaid**: pay-as-you-go.
- **Prepaid**: subscription
v1_parameters.help_zh:
付费类型，取值范围如下： 

- **Postpaid**：按量付费。
- **Prepaid**：预付费（包年包月）
v1_parameters.name: PayType

v1_parameters.help_en:
This parameter is required when **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**. Pass this parameter to specify whether the upfront cluster uses a yearly or monthly billing cycle. 

- **Year**: The subscription period is measured in years.
- **Month**: The subscription period is measured in months
v1_parameters.help_zh:
若付费类型为**Prepaid**时，该参数为必传参数。指定预付费集群为包年或包月类型。 

- **Year**：包年。即选择包年包月时，单位为年。
- **Month**：包月。即选择包年包月时，单位为月
v1_parameters.name: Period

v1_parameters.help_en: The coupon code. If not specified, the default coupon is used
v1_parameters.help_zh: 优惠券编号，不填时使用默认优惠券
v1_parameters.name: PromotionCode

v1_parameters.help_en:
The provisioned read/write IOPS of the ESSD AutoPL cloud disk. Valid values: 0 to min{50,000, 1000 × capacity - baseline performance}.

Baseline performance = min{1,800 + 50 × capacity, 50,000}.

This parameter is supported only when StorageType is set to ESSDAUTOPL.
v1_parameters.help_zh:
ESSD AutoPL云盘预配置的读写IOPS。可能值：0~min{50,000, 1000*容量-基准性能}。

基准性能=min{1,800+50*容量, 50000}。

当StorageType为ESSDAUTOPL时才支持该参数。
v1_parameters.name: ProvisionedIops

v1_parameters.help_en:
The specification of the database proxy for Standard Edition. Valid values:

- **polar.maxscale.g2.medium.c**: 2 cores.
- **polar.maxscale.g2.large.c**: 4 cores.
- **polar.maxscale.g2.xlarge.c**: 8 cores.
- **polar.maxscale.g2.2xlarge.c**: 16 cores.
- **polar.maxscale.g2.3xlarge.c**: 24 cores.
- **polar.maxscale.g2.4xlarge.c**: 32 cores.
- **polar.maxscale.g2.8xlarge.c**: 64 cores
v1_parameters.help_zh:
标准版数据库代理规格。取值如下：

- **polar.maxscale.g2.medium.c**：2核。
- **polar.maxscale.g2.large.c**：4核。
- **polar.maxscale.g2.xlarge.c**：8核。
- **polar.maxscale.g2.2xlarge.c**：16核。
- **polar.maxscale.g2.3xlarge.c**：24核。
- **polar.maxscale.g2.4xlarge.c**：32核。
- **polar.maxscale.g2.8xlarge.c**：64核
v1_parameters.name: ProxyClass

v1_parameters.help_en:
The type of the database proxy. Valid values:
- **EXCLUSIVE**: Dedicated Enterprise Edition.
- **GENERAL**: Standard Enterprise Edition.
> The proxy type must match the type that corresponds to the node specifications of the cluster:
> - If the node specifications are General-purpose, set the proxy type to Standard Enterprise Edition.
> - If the node specifications are Dedicated, set the proxy type to Dedicated Enterprise Edition
v1_parameters.help_zh:
数据库代理类型，取值范围如下：
- **EXCLUSIVE**：企业独享版
- **GENERAL**：企业通用版
>代理类型需要与集群的节点规格对应的类型保持一致。即：
>- 节点规格为通用规格，则代理类型应为企业通用版；
>- 节点规格为独享规格，则代理类型应为企业独享版
v1_parameters.name: ProxyType

v1_parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

> You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html operation to query available regions
v1_parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

> 您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/98041.html接口查看可用地域
v1_parameters.name: RegionId

v1_parameters.help_en: The resource group ID
v1_parameters.help_zh: 资源组ID
v1_parameters.name: ResourceGroupId

v1_parameters.help_en:
The maximum scaling limit for a single node. Valid values: 1 PCU to 32 PCU.
> Only serverless clusters support this parameter
v1_parameters.help_zh:
单节点伸缩上限。取值范围：1 PCU~32 PCU。
> 仅Serverless集群支持该参数
v1_parameters.name: ScaleMax

v1_parameters.help_en:
The minimum scaling limit for a single node. Valid values: 1 PCU to 31 PCU.

> Only serverless clusters support this parameter
v1_parameters.help_zh:
单节点伸缩下限。取值范围：1 PCU~31 PCU。

> 仅Serverless集群支持该参数
v1_parameters.name: ScaleMin

v1_parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of read-only nodes for scaling. Valid values: 0 to 15.
> Only serverless clusters support this parameter
v1_parameters.help_zh:
只读节点个数伸缩上限。取值范围：0~15。
> 仅Serverless集群支持该参数
v1_parameters.name: ScaleRoNumMax

v1_parameters.help_en:
The minimum number of read-only nodes for scaling. Valid values: 0 to 15.
> Only serverless clusters support this parameter
v1_parameters.help_zh:
只读节点个数伸缩下限。取值范围：0~15。
> 仅Serverless集群支持该参数
v1_parameters.name: ScaleRoNumMin

v1_parameters.help_en:
The IP addresses in the whitelist of the PolarDB cluster.
> You can specify multiple IP addresses. Separate multiple IP addresses with commas (,)
v1_parameters.help_zh:
PolarDB集群白名单IP地址。
>支持配置多个白名单IP地址，多个IP地址之间使用英文逗号分隔
v1_parameters.name: SecurityIPList

v1_parameters.help_en:
The serverless type. Set the value to **AgileServerless** (agile).
> Only serverless clusters support this parameter
v1_parameters.help_zh:
Serverless类型。当前取值固定为**AgileServerless**（敏态）。
> 仅Serverless集群支持该参数
v1_parameters.name: ServerlessType

v1_parameters.help_en:
Instance ID of the source ApsaraDB RDS instance or the source PolarDB cluster. This parameter is required only when **CreationOption** is set to **MigrationFromRDS**, **CloneFromRDS**, **CloneFromPolarDB**, or **RecoverFromRecyclebin**.
* If **CreationOption** is set to **MigrationFromRDS** or **CloneFromRDS**, set this parameter to instance ID of the source ApsaraDB RDS instance. The source ApsaraDB RDS instance must run RDS MySQL 5.6, 5.7, or 8.0 on RDS High-availability Edition.

* If **CreationOption** is set to **CloneFromPolarDB**, set this parameter to instance ID of the source PolarDB cluster. The cloned cluster and the source cluster have the same DBType by default. For example, if the source cluster runs MySQL 8.0, set **DBType** to **MySQL** and **DBVersion** to **8.0** for the cloned cluster.
* If **CreationOption** is set to **RecoverFromRecyclebin**, set this parameter to instance ID of the released source PolarDB cluster. The recovered cluster and the source cluster must have the same DBType. For example, if the source cluster runs MySQL 8.0, set **DBType** to **MySQL** and **DBVersion** to **8.0** for the recovered cluster
v1_parameters.help_zh:
源RDS实例ID或源PolarDB集群ID。仅当**CreationOption**为**MigrationFromRDS**、**CloneFromRDS**、**CloneFromPolarDB**或**RecoverFromRecyclebin**时，该参数必填。
* 若**CreationOption**为**MigrationFromRDS**或**CloneFromRDS**，您需要为本参数传入源RDS实例ID。源RDS实例版本需为RDS MySQL 5.6 、5.7或8.0高可用版。

* 若**CreationOption**为**CloneFromPolarDB**，您需要为本参数传入源PolarDB集群ID。克隆集群和源集群的DBType默认保持一致。例如源集群为MySQL 8.0，则克隆集群也需设置**DBType**为**MySQL**且**DBVersion**为**8.0**。
* 若**CreationOption**为**RecoverFromRecyclebin**，您需要为本参数传入已释放的源PolarDB集群ID。从回收站恢复的集群和源集群的DBType需保持一致。例如源集群为MySQL 8.0，则从回收站恢复的集群也需设置**DBType**为**MySQL**且**DBVersion**为**8.0**
v1_parameters.name: SourceResourceId

v1_parameters.help_en: The UID of the account that owns the source backup set in cross-account backup restoration scenarios
v1_parameters.help_zh: 跨账号备份恢复场景下源备份集所属uid
v1_parameters.name: SourceUid

v1_parameters.help_en:
The zone of the hot standby cluster.

> This parameter takes effect only when the hot standby cluster or multi-zone strong data consistency is enabled
v1_parameters.help_zh:
热备集群的可用区。

> 开启了热备集群或多可用区数据强一致，该参数才生效
v1_parameters.name: StandbyAZ

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic storage scaling for Standard Edition clusters. Valid values:

- Enable: Automatic storage scaling is enabled.
- Disable: Automatic storage scaling is shutdown
v1_parameters.help_zh:
标准版集群是否开启存储自动扩容。取值范围如下：

- Enable：开启存储自动扩容。
- Disable：关闭存储自动扩容
v1_parameters.name: StorageAutoScale

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable cloud disk encryption. Valid values:

- **true**: Cloud disk encryption is enabled.
- **false**: Cloud disk encryption is disabled. This is the default value.
> This parameter takes effect only when **DBType** is set to **MySQL**.

> This parameter takes effect only when **StorageType** is set to a Standard Edition storage type
v1_parameters.help_zh:
是否开启云盘加密。取值范围如下：

- **true**: 开启。
- **false**: 关闭（默认值）。
> 当参数**DBType**为**MySQL**时，该参数才生效。

> 仅参数**StorageType**为标准版存储类型时，该参数才生效
v1_parameters.name: StorageEncryption

v1_parameters.help_en:
The ID of the custom encryption key for cloud disk encryption in the same region as the instance. Specifying this parameter automatically enables cloud disk encryption, which cannot be disabled after it is enabled. Leave this parameter empty to use the default service key for cloud disk encryption.

You can view the key ID in the Key Management Service (KMS) console or create a new key.

> This parameter takes effect only when **DBType** is set to **MySQL**.

> This parameter takes effect only when **StorageType** is set to a Standard Edition storage type
v1_parameters.help_zh:
实例同地域内的云盘加密自定义密钥 ID。传入此参数表示自动开启云盘加密（开启后无法关闭）。若使用默认的服务密钥进行云盘加密请留空该参数。

您可以在密钥管理服务控制台查看密钥 ID，也可以创建新的密钥。

> 当参数**DBType**为**MySQL**时，该参数才生效。

> 仅参数**StorageType**为标准版存储类型时，该参数才生效
v1_parameters.name: StorageEncryptionKey

v1_parameters.help_en:
The billing type for storage. Valid values:

- Postpaid: pay-by-capacity (pay-as-you-go).
- Prepaid: pay-by-space (subscription)
v1_parameters.help_zh:
存储计费类型。取值范围如下：

- Postpaid：按容量计费（按量付费）。
- Prepaid：按空间计费（包年包月）
v1_parameters.name: StoragePayType

v1_parameters.help_en:
The storage space for subscription billing (pay-by-space). Unit: GB.
> - Valid values for PolarDB for MySQL Enterprise Edition: 10 to 50000.
> - Valid values for PolarDB for MySQL Standard Edition: 20 to 64000.
> - When the Standard Edition storage type is ESSDAUTOPL, valid values are 40 to 64000 with a minimum step of 10. Only values such as 40, 50, 60, and so on are accepted
v1_parameters.help_zh:
按空间计费（包年包月）的存储空间。单位：GB。
> - PolarDB MySQL企业版存储空间的取值范围：10~50000。
> - PolarDB MySQL标准版存储空间的取值范围：20~64000。
> - 标准版存储类型为ESSDAUTOPL时，存储空间的取值范围：40~64000，步长最小为10，即只能填写40、50、60...以此类推
v1_parameters.name: StorageSpace

v1_parameters.help_en:
Valid values for Enterprise Edition storage type:
- **PSL5**
- **PSL4**

Valid values for Standard Edition storage type:
- **ESSDPL0**
- **ESSDPL1**
- **ESSDPL2**
- **ESSDPL3**
- **ESSDAUTOPL**
v1_parameters.help_zh:
企业版存储类型取值如下：
- **PSL5**
- **PSL4**

标准版存储类型取值如下：
- **ESSDPL0**
- **ESSDPL1**
- **ESSDPL2**
- **ESSDPL3**
- **ESSDAUTOPL**
v1_parameters.name: StorageType

v1_parameters.help_en:
Sets the upper limit for automatic storage scaling of Standard Edition clusters. Unit: GB.

> The maximum value is 32000
v1_parameters.help_zh:
设置标准版集群存储自动扩容上限，单位：GB。

> 取值最大为32000
v1_parameters.name: StorageUpperBound

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether multi-zone strong data consistency is enabled for the cluster. Valid values:

- **ON**: Multi-zone strong data consistency is enabled. This value applies to the Standard Edition 3AZ scenario.

- **OFF**: Multi-zone strong data consistency is disabled
v1_parameters.help_zh:
集群是否开启了多可用区数据强一致。取值范围如下：

- **ON**：表示开启了多可用区数据强一致，适用于标准版3AZ场景。

- **OFF**：表示未开启多可用区数据强一致
v1_parameters.name: StrictConsistency

v1_parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable Transparent Data Encryption (TDE). Valid values:

- **true**: TDE is enabled.
- **false**: TDE is disabled. This is the default value.

> * This parameter takes effect only when **DBType** is set to **PostgreSQL** or **Oracle**.
> * You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167982.html operation to enable TDE for a PolarDB for MySQL cluster.
> * TDE cannot be disabled after it is enabled
v1_parameters.help_zh:
开启TDE加密。取值范围如下：

- **true**：开启。
- **false**：关闭（默认值）。

> * 仅当**DBType**为**PostgreSQL**或**Oracle**时，本参数生效。
> * 您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/167982.html接口为PolarDB MySQL集群开启TDE加密。
> * TDE功能开启后不可关闭
v1_parameters.name: TDEStatus

This parameter is required when **PayType** is set to **Prepaid**.
- When **Period** is set to **Month**, the valid values of **UsedTime** are integers in the range of `[1-9]`.
- When **Period** is set to **Year**, the valid values of **UsedTime** are integers in the range of `[1-3]`
v1_parameters.help_zh:
若付费类型为**Prepaid**时，该参数为必传参数。
- 当**Period**为**Month**时，**UsedTime**取值为整数类型，取值范围为`[1-9]`。
- 当**Period**为**Year**时，**UsedTime**取值为整数类型，取值范围为`[1-3]`
v1_parameters.name: UsedTime
